scale_basis: The image width is set to 40.0 m, kept from layout.json map_extent_m. Z = 40 x 9/16 = 22.5 m. Cross-check against the scale anchors: the elm crowns are drawn about 9-10 m across, which suits mature hedgerow/riverside elms, and the willow crown about 7 m. The Bible gives no plan dimension. Y = 20 m, covering the elm crowns.
orientation_note: North at top; the backwater is at the west (left), the meadow and the way to the hedge at the east (right).

objects.collision: none (water surface marker; the real waterline is 1.2 m below the bank top)

walkable.bank_lip: x about 0.265-0.31: the bare-earth lip where the 1.2 m bank drops at about 25 degrees to the water. Sitting on or stepping down it is possible; walking west of x 0.265 means being in the water.
walkable.sitting_shelf: x 0.31-0.55, between the two elms: flat grass shaded by the elm crowns (undersides at 6 m). This is where the sister sits with Alice. Clear except the two elm trunks (0.9 m).
walkable.meadow: x 0.55-1.0: open long grass, fully walkable. The field_way exit is at the NE [0.9, 0.22].

inferred_items: The willow trunk stands at the bank edge [0.235, 0.30] under the drawn crown (the trunk is hidden by the crown in the image).
Tree heights: willow 8 m, elms 18 m (crown 6-18 m); trunk diameters 0.8-0.9 m.
The bank's 1.2 m height and 25-degree slope (Bible) are not modelled as terrain; the whitebox ground is the bank-top level.
workflow_notes: No image deviations were found (env-concept self-check). The waking frame is always true scale (1:1). This set is the reference for every dream scale build.
The elm crown depths are trimmed to 7.3 / 7.5 m so the footprints stay inside the frame (both crowns run off the top/bottom edges in the image).
The villa roofline and church spire are skyline-only, off the map; not modelled.

Anti-clip handover: the sister's and Alice's seated positions go on the sitting_shelf. Keep them at least 0.6 m (body radius + 0.15 m) off the elm trunks, and keep any walk to the water's edge above the bank lip.
